title: STM32L476 Embedded Systems Suite
subtitle: Bare-metal builds on STM32L476 boards

maturity.label: Validated with oscilloscope and logic analyzer

pitch: A set of embedded builds on STM32L476 boards covering timers, ADC, GPIO, interrupts, SPI, UART, and DMA.
highlights: LCD stopwatch and timer with joystick input and button interrupts
SPI LED light show on a Pololu strip
IR remote with a custom parsing algorithm
Proximity-enabled audio device: low-pass filter, amplifier, PWM-driven speaker

blocks.md: Four builds on STM32L476 boards: an LCD stopwatch and timer (joystick input, button interrupts), an SPI LED light show (Pololu strip), an IR remote with a custom parsing algorithm, and a proximity-enabled audio device (low-pass filter, amplifier, PWM-driven speaker). Together they cover timers, ADC, GPIO, interrupts, SPI, UART, and DMA, validated with oscilloscope and logic analyzer.
